transcript.text: Hey everyone, the Monday production launch for the public GraphQL API is coming up fast. I want to make sure we're all aligned on the production API policy before we go live. The current draft has 300 requests per minute with a burst of 30, permits schema introspection, allows query depth 12, and has no tenant-specific rate tier. But the readiness review checklist calls out tenant rate tiers, dependency-failure behavior, query controls, and customer-specific limits as things we need to address before Monday. I'd like to walk through where we stand on each of those items and what still needs to be decided.
